# repo-routing Skill

Use this skill before creating issues or pull requests.

Implementation changes inside this repository belong here. Platform template,
workspace, submodule pointer, and shared skill changes belong in
`Wecoya/private-sovereign-cloud`.

If the change spans both areas, create linked PRs: implementation first in this
repository, then a platform pointer/template PR.
